trips_may = tables['trips'][(tables['trips']['fished_date_doy'] >= 120) & (tables['trips']['fished_date_doy'] <= 152)]

# Summary by fishing day and class
summary = trips_may.groupby(['fished_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'boat': 'count'
}).reset_index()
summary['yt_per_angler'] = summary['yt'] / summary['anglers']
summary = summary.rename(columns={'boat': 'trips'})

# Sort and display

print("Fleet performance May 1-31 (doy 120-152):")
print(result.to_string())
